name: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI)
monetization: None — $0 revenue by design; a research-only bet on building safe superintelligence 'in a straight shot', monetization explicitly deferred.
description_md: Safe Superintelligence is the research lab founded in June 2024 by OpenAI co-founder and former chief scientist Ilya Sutskever (with Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy), operating from Palo Alto and Tel Aviv. It has raised ~$7B in total at a $32B post-money valuation while shipping no product and publishing no research — the purest expression of the cycle's willingness to fund pre-revenue frontier labs. Its first model was slated for an August 2026 debut per the coverage universe census (unverified).
ai_monetization_md: There is no monetization: SSI states it will not release commercial products on the path to superintelligence, and it recorded $0 revenue through 2025–H1 2026. Its economic footprint is entirely on the spending side — it was reported as Google Cloud's largest external TPU customer before shifting toward GPUs, and Nvidia's reported $5B July 2026 investment comes bundled with access to Vera Rubin systems said to expand SSI's compute ~10× over 12 months.
ai_strategy_md: One product, one milestone: insulate research from commercial pressure by raising enormous sums against Sutskever's reputation (backers across rounds reportedly include Greenoaks, Sequoia, a16z, DST, Alphabet, and Nvidia), buy frontier-scale compute (Google Cloud TPUs, now Nvidia GPUs), and stay dark until superintelligence-relevant results exist. For the money map, SSI matters as a large compute buyer and as the limit case of valuation-without-revenue.
risk_notes_md: The $32B valuation is supported by zero revenue, zero product, and zero published research — the steepest faith-based mark among Tier-1 labs. The Nvidia $5B investment (Jul 2026) is single-sourced in origin (widely re-reported but tracing to one report), so it carries low confidence here; it also adds supplier-investor circularity, with Nvidia funding a customer whose spending returns as GPU purchases. Key-man risk on Sutskever is total; co-founder Daniel Gross already departed for Meta in mid-2025.

observations.notes: $2B raise at $32B (2025, Greenoaks-led, incl. Alphabet and Nvidia); the reported Jul 2026 Nvidia $5B was described as bringing total funding to ~$7B at the same $32B post. Private round mark, not a traded price.

source.title: Nvidia just put $5 billion into a company that has never shipped a product

observations.notes: No product shipped, no research published, $0 revenue — consistently reported and consistent with the company's stated no-product-before-superintelligence position. First model slated Aug 2026 per census (UNVERIFIED).

events.title: Nvidia reportedly invests ~$5B in SSI
events.why_it_matters: Among Nvidia's largest single checks of the cycle, into a company with no product — a landmark data point for the circularity debate (investment funds compute purchases that return to Nvidia as revenue). Reported alongside a Vera Rubin compute partnership; single-sourced in origin, unconfirmed by either company.
